lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn4Zr2O8 (Zn2ZrO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Zn centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Zr centers show eight O neighbors. O centers adopt square-pyramidal or four-coordinate environments, and the Zn octahedra share edges with one another and corners with Zr polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
